<a id="page-data"></a>
# Data: APIs, cloud data, storage and form submission

<a id="data-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

The `data` feature library: calling HTTP APIs, reading and writing the project's cloud documents and files,
storing values on the device, and submitting forms. Not in the agent trust profile at run time (a host enables it).

<a id="data-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

A value saved on the device and read back as `${storage.theme}`:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["prefs"],
  "nodes": {
    "prefs": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 200},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["saved", "save"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 200}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"crossAxisAlignment": "start", "spacing": 12}
    },
    "saved": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "Saved theme: ${storage.theme}", "style": {"fontSize": 15, "color": "#FF111827"}}
    },
    "save": {
      "type": "filledButton",
      "layout": {"width": 160, "height": 44},
      "props": {"label": "Use dark", "style": {"backgroundColor": "#FF111827", "foregroundColor": "#FFFFFFFF"}},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [
            {"type": "setStorage", "key": "theme", "value": "dark"},
            {"type": "showToast", "message": "Saved", "style": "success"}
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="data-reference"></a>
## Reference

<a id="action-callApi"></a>
### `callApi` (action): Call API

Calls API `api` (the publish model's `services.apis`) with `params`, its inputs (expressions; an empty one takes the input's default). Then `onSuccess` runs after a 2xx response, `onError` after any other or a failed request, both reading the response as `${result}`. A failed request without `onError` stops the chain.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `api` | String | `""` |  | An API of services.apis. |
| `params` | Object | unset |  | Its inputs, by name (expressions). |
| `onSuccess` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run after a 2xx response. |
| `onError` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run after a failure. |

<a id="action-setStorage"></a>
### `setStorage` (action): Set storage

Changes the app's values on the device (read as `${storage.<key>}`). A key may be a path (`prefs.theme`) into a stored map or list.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [StorageOperation](values.md#enum-StorageOperation) | `"write"` | `write`, `remove`, `clear` |  |
| `key` | String | `""` |  | The key; may be a path. Not for clear. |
| `valueType` | [VariableType](values.md#enum-VariableType) | `"text"` | `integer`, `text`, `decimal`, `boolean`, `color`, `list`, `map`, `image`, `choice` | How the written value is read (write only). |
| `op` | [WriteOp](values.md#enum-WriteOp) | `"set"` | `set`, `toggle`, `add`, `subtract`, `insert`, `insertAll`, `removeAt`, `remove`, `update` | How the value changes. |
| `value` | String | `""` |  | The value (an expression); not for toggle, removeAt. |
| `index` | String | `""` |  | A list index (an expression). |
| `mapKey` | String | `""` |  | A map key (an expression). |
| `skipIfExists` | bool | `false` |  | Leaves a key that has a value. |

<a id="action-cloudDocuments"></a>
### `cloudDocuments` (action): Cloud documents

Writes documents of a cloud collection: one at a time by id, or many at once.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [CloudDocumentsOperation](values.md#enum-CloudDocumentsOperation) | `"add"` | `add`, `update`, `remove`, `removeMany`, `setMany` |  |
| `path` | String | `""` |  | The collection path (an expression). |
| `id` | String | `""` |  | The document id (an expression). |
| `autoId` | bool | `false` |  | Add: a generated id. |
| `skipIfExists` | bool | `true` |  | Add only. |
| `document` | String | `""` |  | The document (add) or documents (setMany): an expression, or JSON text. |
| `raw` | bool | `false` |  | The document is taken as written: no expressions. |
| `field` | String | `""` |  | Update: the field (a path). |
| `valueType` | [VariableType](values.md#enum-VariableType) | `"text"` | `integer`, `text`, `decimal`, `boolean`, `color`, `list`, `map`, `image`, `choice` | Update only. |
| `op` | [WriteOp](values.md#enum-WriteOp) | `"set"` | `set`, `toggle`, `add`, `subtract`, `insert`, `insertAll`, `removeAt`, `remove`, `update` | How the value changes. |
| `value` | String | `""` |  | The value (an expression); not for toggle, removeAt. |
| `index` | String | `""` |  | A list index (an expression). |
| `mapKey` | String | `""` |  | A map key (an expression). |
| `ids` | String | `""` |  | RemoveMany: ids, comma separated or a list. |
| `whereFilters` | Object | unset |  | RemoveMany: the filters. |
| `idField` | String | `"id"` |  |  |
| `merge` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `replaceCollection` | bool | `false` |  |  |

<a id="action-loadCloudData"></a>
### `loadCloudData` (action): Load cloud data

Streams a cloud document, or a collection query's documents, into variable `variable` while the screen shows: `{status: loading|loaded| error, isLoading, data, error, hasMore}`. A variable of type list gets the documents themselves, and with an `aggregate`, a number variable the number. Blocking actions wait for the first value; an initial failure stops the chain. A later subscription failure stops any remaining actions from that invocation and fires the canvas's actionError reaction. Subscriptions close on error or when the screen is disposed.

One variable has one live load: running the action again (or a `ReloadCloudDataAction`) replaces the earlier subscription. Unless `reactive` is false, the load runs again by itself when a value its query reads changes (`${auth.uid}`, `${search}`, a `limit` bound to a variable), but never for a change of its own variable.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `single` | bool | `true` |  | One document, or the query's documents. |
| `id` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `query` | Object | unset |  | The collection and, for a query, its filters, sorts, limit and joins (a CloudQueryDef). |
| `scope` | [CloudDataScope](values.md#enum-CloudDataScope) | `"screen"` | `screen`, `app` | Screen: a subscription per screen, until it goes. App: one subscription the whole app shares, into an app variable every screen reads. |
| `limit` | String | `""` |  | The most documents: a number or expression; empty: the query's, else 500; 0: all. |
| `aggregate` | [CloudLoadAggregate](values.md#enum-CloudLoadAggregate) | `"none"` | `none`, `count`, `sum`, `average` | A number (count, sum, average) instead of the documents, without loading them. |
| `aggregateField` | String | `""` |  | Sum and average: the field. |
| `refreshSeconds` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Aggregate: also runs again this often (writes made elsewhere); 0: after this app's writes only. |
| `reactive` | bool | `true` |  | Runs again when a value its query reads changes (${auth.uid}, a bound limit). |

<a id="action-reloadCloudData"></a>
### `reloadCloudData` (action): Reload cloud data

Runs again the live load of `variable` (a `LoadCloudDataAction` that ran on this screen): it subscribes afresh, with the values its query reads now, and waits for the first value. Nothing when the variable has no load. A list's pull to refresh (its `refresh` reaction) runs it.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | A variable a load cloud data action fills. |

<a id="action-cloudFiles"></a>
### `cloudFiles` (action): Cloud files

Uploads files the user picks to (or deletes them from) cloud storage folder `path`; `actions` run with each file (`${result.url}`...). With a `source`, it uploads that value instead of asking the user (a captured screenshot, a drawing).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [CloudFilesOperation](values.md#enum-CloudFilesOperation) | `"upload"` | `upload`, `delete` |  |
| `path` | String | `""` |  | The storage folder. |
| `kind` | [CloudFileKind](values.md#enum-CloudFileKind) | `"image"` | `image`, `any` |  |
| `allowMultiple` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `maxSizeMB` | double | `10` |  |  |
| `progressVariable` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `access` | [CloudFileAccess](values.md#enum-CloudFileAccess) | `"public"` | `public`, `private` |  |
| `source` | String | `""` |  | Uploads this instead of asking the user: a data: URL (${result.image} of a screenshot), or a list. |
| `fileName` | String | `""` |  | The name a source file is stored under. |
| `actions` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run with each file. |

<a id="action-cloudData"></a>
### `cloudData` (action): Cloud data

Creates, updates, deletes, reads, queries or aggregates documents of a collection. Its result (the new id, the document, the documents, the number) is the chain's `${result}` and goes in `resultVariable`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [CloudDataOperation](values.md#enum-CloudDataOperation) | `"create"` | `create`, `update`, `delete`, `get`, `query`, `count`, `sum`, `average` |  |
| `collection` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `id` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `fields` | Object | unset |  | Field writes: [{"field", "value", "operation"}]. |
| `whereFilters` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `orderByFilters` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `limit` | int | unset |  |  |
| `aggregateField` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `loadRelated` | List<String> | `[]` |  |  |
| `resultVariable` | String | `""` |  |  |

<a id="action-cloudBatch"></a>
### `cloudBatch` (action): Cloud batch

Several `CloudDataAction` writes (create, update, delete) committed at once. With `forEach`, `steps` run once per item of that list (`${loop.item}`, `${loop.index}`), every write in the same commit: "mark all read" in one write instead of one per item.

Up to `kMaxCloudBatchWrites` writes are all or none. More are committed in chunks of that size, each all or none; with `transaction`, more fail before anything is written. A batch with a read step (get, query, count, sum, average) runs its steps one by one, as before.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | Object | unset |  | Nested cloudData actions. |
| `transaction` | bool | `false` |  | All or none: more than 500 writes fail instead of committing in chunks. |
| `forEach` | String | `""` |  | A list: the steps run per item (${loop.item}, ${loop.index}), all in one commit. |

<a id="action-submitForm"></a>
### `submitForm` (action): Submit form

Validates a form's answers and stores them in the app's own variables (`service: local`). See `docs/submit_form.md`.

A remote destination is an explicit later action (`callApi` in `onSuccess`) to an endpoint the app defines; this action itself never calls a service.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `service` | [FormService](values.md#enum-FormService) | `"local"` | `local` | Only `local` is offered: `FormService.unsupported` marks old data. |
| `payload` | String | `""` |  | An expression yielding a JSON object. |
| `validationScript` | String | `""` |  | Await a script returning {valid, errors?, payload?}. |
| `validationArguments` | Object | unset |  | Named script argument expressions. |
| `responseVariable` | String | `""` |  | Optional mutable list variable receiving the validated payload. Persist the variable to keep submissions. |
| `prepend` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `resultVariable` | String | `""` |  | An expression yielding a JSON object. An awaited validator may replace it with its normalized `payload`. |
| `onSuccess` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `onError` | Object | unset |  |  |

<a id="data-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="data-call-an-api-and-show-the-result"></a>
### Call an API and show the result

`callApi` names an API of the publish model (`services.apis`: method, URL, headers, body with `${input}`
placeholders) and passes `params`; its result is `${result}` in `onSuccess` (store it with `setVariable`), the
error in `onError`. Show a loading state with a variable set before the call and cleared in both chains.

<a id="data-cloud-documents"></a>
### Cloud documents

`cloudData` creates, updates, deletes, reads, queries or aggregates documents of a collection (`whereFilters`,
`orderByFilters`, `limit`); its result goes in `resultVariable`. A list bound to a cloud query loads its pages
through the list's `pagination`.

<a id="data-storage-on-the-device"></a>
### Storage on the device

`setStorage` writes `${storage.<key>}` (a key may be a path into a stored map or list; `op` as `setVariable`'s:
`set`, `add` appends to a list, `insert` puts at an `index`, `remove` takes a value out). A variable with
`"persist": true` is kept on the device too.

- **Restore on load**: a canvas `load` reaction copies storage into a variable, `{"type": "setVariable",
  "variable": "saved", "value": "${= coalesce(storage.saved, [])}"}`; write it back after each change with
  `{"type": "setStorage", "key": "saved", "valueType": "list", "value": "${saved}"}`.
- **A key per page or item** (a checklist per route): the key is an expression, `"key": "packed.${route.id}"` with
  `"op": "add"`, `"valueType": "list"`, `"value": "${item}"`; read it with `${= coalesce(get(storage.packed,
  route.id), [])}`. A persisted variable is one value for every route.
- The render command keeps storage in memory for one run: steps and `--navigate` see what earlier steps wrote; each
  size and each run starts empty.

A whole site using both: [a complete site](components.md#components-a-complete-multi-page-site).

<a id="data-submit-a-form"></a>
### Submit a form

`submitForm` validates the answers and stores them (`service: local`), or sends them to a destination the project
declares; `onSuccess` and `onError` run after. See `docs/submit_form.md` in the package.

<a id="data-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- These actions are not in the agent trust profile: a runtime model may document them but not use them unless the
  host allows the `data` catalog.
- An API's URL and secrets live in the publish model, never in the document.
- `${result}` is the response only inside `onSuccess`.
